description: Reverse-engineer a competitor TikTok or Instagram Reels ad: hook type and why it works, the segment-by-segment structure, selling points, call to action, and 2-3 copywriting moves worth reusing. Pass a public video link, or paste the ad text if you already have it. Returns a breakdown_id you can hand to rewrite_ad_for_product.

notes.description: Optional context, e.g. "skincare brand, US market".

transcript.description: The ad caption or voiceover text. Use this when you already have the text or when transcription is unavailable.

video_url.description: Public TikTok or Instagram Reels ad URL.

name: breakdown_ad
title: Break down a short-form video ad
